Name: (Calcifer) Ash's Japanese Furniture Collection
Author: Tortart
Description:
[b][color=#e06666][size=5]Just like the Content Patcher version, please note that this mod was so big (in terms of different colours) that I had to split it into different colour-coded files + a miscellaneous file for the ones that aren't matched to a color. You can also download the All-in-one Megapack if you want everything in fewer clicks.[/size]
[/color]
[/b][size=4]Anywho, ANOTHER long list of stuff incoming:[/size]

[left][size=4]Colour-coded items (comes in [color=#b6b6b6]black[/color], white and [color=#ffe599]light [/color]and [color=#bf9000]dark [/color]variations of [color=#e06666]red[/color], [color=#e69138]orange[/color], [color=#ffe599]yellow[/color], [color=#6aa84f]green[/color], [color=#76a5af]teal[/color], [color=#6fa8dc]blue[/color], [color=#8e7cc3]purple[/color], [color=#d5a6bd]pink [/color]and [color=#cc4125]brown[/color]):
[color=#dbb0a7]- Armchairs
- Darkwood & Lightwood Cushioned Chairs (1 stool type, 2 chair types, 2 bench types & 1 long bench type)
- Couches
- Double Bed Futons (1 without headboard, 1 with darkwood headboard & 1 with lightwood headboard)
- Darkwood & Lightwood Kontatsu
- Manga & Fallen Manga
- Darkwood & Lightwood Partitions 
- Darkwood & Lightwood Tables with cloths on them
- Wallpapers with Darkwood & Lightwood Accents[/color][/size][/left]
[size=4]

And for the miscellaneous stuff not included with the colour-coded stuff:
[color=#dbb0a7]- Anime Dolls (Currently has characters from: Sailor Moon, My Hero Academia, Demon Slayer & Vocaloid)
- Calico Armchair and Couch
- Darkwood & Lightwood Chairs (1 stool type, 2 chair types, 2 bench types & 1 long bench type)
- Shouryouma Couch
- Wooden and Tatami Flooring
- Stacks of Manga
- Darkwood & Lightwood Framed Landscape Paintings
- Darkwood & Lightwood Decorative Shamisen
- Darkwood & Lightwood Shelf, Cabinet and Wardrobe Pieces (Short, Medium, Tall & Extra Tall)
- Darkwood & Lightwood Tables [b]without[/b] cloths on them
- Darkwood & Lightwood Decorative Taiko Drums
- Darkwood & Lightwood Tall & Tiny Lamps
- Darkwood & Lightwood Wall Beams (Right, Middle, Left)
- Darkwood & Lightwood Baths (yeah, these are "functional" bc I used the chair coding to be able to sit in them)
- Darkwood & Lightwood Windows (6 wide windows, each with curtain variants, and 2 round ones)[/color][/size]
[center][/center]
[size=4]Also I feel like I should apologise AGAIN in advance for some of the furniture names being super long... whoops;-; Anyway, see you in another blue moon with a mod[/size]
